lines.en: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
lines.cn: 佩奇先生教书已经有多久了？

lines.en: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
lines.cn: 我刚刚收到我母校寄来的一封信，信中告诉我，我的前任校长斯图尔特·佩奇先生将于下周退休。

lines.en: Pupils of the school old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
lines.cn: 无论是学校的老同学还是新同学，都会送他一份礼物来庆祝这个特殊的日子。

lines.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
lines.cn: 所有为这份礼物出过力的人都会在一张大相册上签名，然后这张相册会被寄到校长的家中。

lines.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
lines.cn: 我们都会永远铭记佩奇先生——他总是充满耐心与理解，每当我们极不情愿地去上学时，他总会给予我们鼓励与支持。

lines.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
lines.cn: 许多他的老同学将会参加下周四为他举办的告别晚宴。

lines.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
lines.cn: 一个奇怪的巧合是：在佩奇先生退休的前一天，他的教学生涯将达到整整四十年。

lines.en: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
lines.cn: 退休后，他将全身心投入到园艺活动中去。

lines.en: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
lines.cn: 对他来说，这将是一个全新的爱好。

lines.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
lines.cn: 但这并不重要，因为正如他经常说的那样：人永远都不应该停止学习。
